lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, with the spots acting as focal nodes at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits contains a high-density population of smaller, more concentrated white punctate marks compared to the larger, more spaced blobs on the flank.
